verdict.rationale: Intel's first-party page names an on-chip Intel Xe Media Engine for playing, streaming and editing at once, so a hardware media engine is documented. However, no specific codecs or encode/decode capabilities are listed. Missing for 10: documented AV1 encode/decode, HEVC encode/decode, ProRes-class codec support, any codec spec sheet, and independent or hands-on corroboration of media-engine performance.

support.subject: As a creator, hardware media engines carry my editing and streaming — documented hardware encode and decode (AV1, HEVC, ProRes-class) on the chip itself

citations.quote: Play, stream, and edit, all at once. Intel Xe Media Engine delivers sharp, high-def video without compromising game graphics.
Tackle 3D models, long edits, and heavy exports with Intel® Arc™ graphics, even unplugged and on-the-go.
